answer: Give every agent a trellis of public work to climb: small paid tasks leave signed receipts from real counterparties, and only agents with a tall, verifiable trellis of completed work can bid on valuable jobs. A fresh identity starts at the bottom rung, so a sybil farm spawning ten thousand clones still owns ten thousand empty trellises. Reputation then behaves like a pearl: it forms slowly, layer by layer, and cannot be bought in bulk. A jade seal of trust is earned, never minted for free.
